title: Final cross-surface presentation seal

merge_window_decision.reason: PRES-G3 is the authoritative presentation seal; RMP-X01/X02 begin a separate roadmap-policy scope.

promises: Seal X01..X08/G1/G2 plus R01/R02/R03/G2R/UX01 at the concrete runtime fixed point.
Remove the last Rich Live terminal ownership from terminal/studio HUD modes instead of merely documenting it as legacy.
Use a Textual terminal HUD over the existing canonical HUD/RUN projection; do not create another truth store.
Keep studio as web plus the same Textual terminal projection and clean up its background HTTP server on exit.
Make terminal --once non-live and safe when TERM is unset, closing the long-standing non-interactive terminal-clear issue.
Preserve terminal/v3 and studio/v5/all CLI aliases and all machine/web/Android/desktop projection contracts.
Require native Textual App.run_test/Pilot qualification across R01, H02, R02, R03, UX01 and the new terminal HUD.
Leave no presentation-owned mutation or execution truth outside canonical RUN/EXO/LIFE/DIST/TEST/EXEC authorities.
